subject: math
question: 设 $f(x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上连续可导， $f(0) = f(1) = 0$ ，且满足 $\int_0^1 [f'(x)]^2 \mathrm{d}x - 8\int_0^1 f(x) \mathrm{d}x + \frac{4}{3} = 0$ ，求 $f(x)$ .

steps.text: 分析 由 $f(0) = f(1) = 0$ ，知 $\int_0^1 f(x)\mathrm{d}x = -\int_0^1 xf'(x)\mathrm{d}x, \int_0^1 f'(x)\mathrm{d}x = 0.$ 从而题设条件可转化为 $\int_0^1 [f'(x)]^2\mathrm{d}x + 2\int_0^1 (4x - k)f'(x)\mathrm{d}x + \frac{4}{3} = 0.$ 只需确定 $k$ 的值，使 $\int_0^1 (4x - k)^2\mathrm{d}x = \frac{4}{3}$ ，就有 $\int_0^1 [f'(x) + 4x - k]^2\mathrm{d}x = 0\Leftrightarrow f'(x) + 4x - k = 0.$ 问题就解决了.

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = - \int_ {0} ^ {1} x f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x, \quad \int_ {0} ^ {1} f ^ {\prime} (x) \mathrm{d} x = 0.
$$
